propositions: A plan-review attestation with explicitly declared file_impact_scope: none should remain valid after an unrelated commit moves HEAD, skipping whole-HEAD drift evaluation.
An empty dependency map without explicit none scope classification should continue to return stale-head after HEAD moves, preserving legacy conservative behavior.

The manifest serialization must emit exactly one authenticated file-scope: none declaration for none-classified records while keeping paths and unscoped output byte-identical to pre-feature contracts.
A file-scope: none declaration present only in unauthenticated plaintext without signed authentication cannot suppress stale-head validity.
Changes to scope classification or no_file_impact_reason in a none-scoped ticket after signing must invalidate the attestation as stale-material due to fingerprint divergence.
